export const meta = {
  name: 'final-audit-100',
  description: 'Definitive per-task audit of all 100 StudioBench V3 tasks across 5 dimensions: hardness (real hard freelance commission, not a subtask), connector-doability, verifier quality (auto + human), asset accuracy/matching (incl. image spot-check for real-brand leaks), and deliverable realism',
  phases: [{ title: 'Audit' }],
}

const BASE = '/Users/dhiren/Downloads/Deccan/Adobe-Freelance-Leads'
const IDS = []
for (let i = 1; i <= 30; i++) IDS.push('PHOTO-' + String(i).padStart(2, '0'))
for (let i = 1; i <= 15; i++) IDS.push('VECTOR-' + String(i).padStart(2, '0'))
for (let i = 1; i <= 35; i++) IDS.push('LAYOUT-' + String(i).padStart(2, '0'))
for (let i = 1; i <= 20; i++) IDS.push('MOTION-' + String(i).padStart(2, '0'))

const SCHEMA = {
  type: 'object',
  properties: {
    task_id: { type: 'string' },
    hardness: { type: 'string', enum: ['HARD', 'BORDERLINE', 'EASY'] },
    is_composite_not_subtask: { type: 'boolean' },
    hard_for_a_human: { type: 'boolean' },
    connector_doability: { type: 'string', enum: ['DOABLE', 'RISKY', 'NOT_DOABLE'] },
    doability_issue: { type: 'string' },
    verifiers_auto_objective: { type: 'boolean' },
    verifiers_human_subjective: { type: 'boolean' },
    verifiers_cover_all: { type: 'boolean' },
    verifier_issue: { type: 'string' },
    assets_match_spec: { type: 'boolean' },
    real_brand_leak_in_images: { type: 'boolean' },
    leaked_files: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
    asset_issue: { type: 'string' },
    deliverables_realistic_and_hard: { type: 'boolean' },
    deliverable_issue: { type: 'string' },
    overall: { type: 'string', enum: ['GO', 'FIX'] },
    top_issues: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
  },
  required: ['task_id', 'hardness', 'is_composite_not_subtask', 'hard_for_a_human', 'connector_doability',
    'verifiers_auto_objective', 'verifiers_human_subjective', 'verifiers_cover_all', 'assets_match_spec',
    'real_brand_leak_in_images', 'deliverables_realistic_and_hard', 'overall', 'top_issues'],
}

const results = await parallel(IDS.map((id) => () => agent(
  `You are the FINAL adversarial auditor for task ${id} of the StudioBench creative-AI benchmark. Be strict: the client wants only genuinely hard, connector-doable, IP-clean, well-verified real-world freelance tasks. Find real problems; do not rubber-stamp.\n\n` +
  `READ:\n` +
  `- Spec: ${BASE}/complex_benchmark/adobe_only/specs_v3/${id}.json (client_brief, brand_identity, assets_supplied, adobe_surfaces[].tools, trajectory, emergent_checkpoints, deliverables, verifiers_auto, verifiers_human, decision_gates, doability_proof)\n` +
  `- Plan: ${BASE}/input_assets_v3/${id}/asset_plan.json\n` +
  `- For DOABILITY, consult ${BASE}/complex_benchmark/adobe_only/CONNECTOR_CAPABILITIES_v3.md and ${BASE}/complex_benchmark/adobe_only/REBUILD_GROUND_TRUTH.md (it lists BANNED patterns, e.g. running a data-merge INTO a convert_pdf_to_indd output because fields will not bind).\n` +
  `- IMAGE SPOT-CHECK: Read 2-4 of this task's generated images from ${BASE}/input_assets_v3/${id}/assets/ — PRIORITISE any food / retail / packaging / storefront / signage / product-label shot (highest real-brand-leak risk). Look at the actual pixels.\n\n` +
  `SCORE these 5 dimensions:\n` +
  `1. HARDNESS: Is this a genuinely HARD, real-world freelance COMMISSION a client would pay for — not a subtask/atomic op dressed up? Would it be hard for a skilled HUMAN designer to execute (real decisions, trap-catching, multi-surface work)? -> hardness HARD/BORDERLINE/EASY, is_composite_not_subtask, hard_for_a_human.\n` +
  `2. CONNECTOR-DOABILITY: Are the declared adobe_surfaces[].tools real Adobe connector functions, and is the trajectory actually ACHIEVABLE with them end-to-end? Flag any banned/broken chain (esp. data-merge into a convert_pdf_to_indd output). -> connector_doability DOABLE/RISKY/NOT_DOABLE + doability_issue.\n` +
  `3. VERIFIERS: Are the verifiers_auto genuinely machine-checkable (each 'how' a deterministic measurement)? Are verifiers_human genuine judgement calls (not auto-able)? Are both TO THE POINT, and do they together COVER every deliverable and every emergent_checkpoint? A human rater must be able to read a verifier, look at the output, and grade it. -> verifiers_auto_objective, verifiers_human_subjective, verifiers_cover_all + verifier_issue.\n` +
  `4. ASSET ACCURACY & MATCHING: Does the asset_plan represent every assets_supplied entry with the engineered defect, and do the GENERATED IMAGES you inspected match the spec's intent AND carry no real brand/logo/trademark baked into the pixels? -> assets_match_spec, real_brand_leak_in_images (+ leaked_files list), asset_issue.\n` +
  `5. DELIVERABLES: Are the 4-7 deliverables realistic, distinct, and hard (real client outputs, not trivial exports)? -> deliverables_realistic_and_hard + deliverable_issue.\n\n` +
  `overall = GO only if hardness is HARD, doability is DOABLE, verifiers are objective+covering, assets match with NO brand leak, and deliverables are strong. Otherwise FIX. List top_issues (empty if none).`,
  { agentType: 'general-purpose', phase: 'Audit', label: `audit:${id}`, schema: SCHEMA }
)))

const r = results.filter(Boolean)
const c = (f) => r.filter(f).map(x => x.task_id)
return {
  audited: r.length,
  GO: r.filter(x => x.overall === 'GO').length,
  FIX: r.filter(x => x.overall === 'FIX').length,
  not_hard: c(x => x.hardness !== 'HARD'),
  subtask_not_composite: c(x => x.is_composite_not_subtask === false),
  not_hard_for_human: c(x => x.hard_for_a_human === false),
  doability_not_doable: c(x => x.connector_doability !== 'DOABLE'),
  verifier_problems: c(x => !x.verifiers_auto_objective || !x.verifiers_human_subjective || !x.verifiers_cover_all),
  asset_mismatch: c(x => x.assets_match_spec === false),
  brand_leaks: r.filter(x => x.real_brand_leak_in_images).map(x => ({ id: x.task_id, files: x.leaked_files })),
  weak_deliverables: c(x => x.deliverables_realistic_and_hard === false),
  fix_list: r.filter(x => x.overall === 'FIX').map(x => ({ id: x.task_id, issues: x.top_issues })),
}

The whole trade-channel deliverable, verifiers A1-A5 + H5, the mark-reproduction-size mechanic and emergent checkpoints #2/#3 cannot be produced from it. Regenerate the PDF (headless Chrome, embedded font subsets, two real placed images, the five runs).

Confirm v3 is the governing doc so this contradiction is settled on the record.

Non-blocking strength: hardness, the five graded images + monogram + CSV assets, the imaging/fonts/Express/Stock chains, all 12 verifiers, and the deliverable design are all strong; only the PDF asset needs a fix.

Broken press PDF: projectcard_2025_print.pdf is a placeholder ('The Vesper'/'[ PIECE IMAGE ]') with none of the required card copy story, no near-square photo well, and no placed image — the foundation of the InDesign merge deliverable (deliverable 4) and two of its engineered defects are absent (assets_match_spec=false).

Doability risk from that PDF: 1,778-byte ReportLab file with non-embedded base-14 Helvetica matches the documented opaque-failure profile for convert_pdf_to_indd, and its no-placed-image well threatens @-image per-row binding — the whole merge spine may not run (connector_doability=RISKY).
